items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Talk about another vocalist. You worked with Ella Fitzgerald.

ctx.x: Talk about another vocalist. You worked with Ella Fitzgerald.

Ah! The best. Yeah, they were all good. Billy Holliday of course was an innovator. She influenced so many other singers, but, and Sarah Vaughn was a fantastic musicians, played piano well, but if I had my druthers, it would be Ella.
Do you like playing with vocalists?
